host_source: Both builds use tests/performance-fixtures/wpf-history-host.cs, derived from 0.3.47 Program.cs with an identical PerformanceContext logging addition. The common AiTests.cs contains AiFakeHandler; the common Program.cs contains reflection, visible-bounds and traversal helpers.
build: dotnet restore --locked-mode -r win-x64 -p:NuGetAudit=false --ignore-failed-sources; dotnet build -c Release -r win-x64 --no-restore
fixture: 120 turns; each has 15 activity rows with 2000-line details and six headings with thirty bold and twelve italic spans. Each version uses its original bold rendering behavior.
window: 900 x 760 DIP initially; width set to 620 + 31 * run for runs 0..7
samples: One warmup and seven recorded iterations, with alternating scroll positions. Every measured interaction waits until DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle; allocations are counted on the UI thread.
sequence: old1,new1,old2,new2,old3,new3 in distinct processes with isolated settings and fake AI connection
